niche: a hepatitis C operational delivery network placing its 2027 find-and-treat outreach team in one of four settings it has not worked (approved premises, homeless hostels, drug service entrants, pharmacy needle exchange registrants), sized by the people it starts on treatment, when part of each setting's antibody-positive intake was cured earlier, by the network's own clinics or inside prison by the prison health provider, and stays antibody positive for life
analyst_test: A strong analyst takes each setting's 2027 intake at its 2025-26 average, the share of that intake the peer programme found antibody positive, removes the positives the network's treatment register shows cured and carries the rest at the three-quarters viraemic share the laboratory's first positives and the 2018-19 pilot validate, and files the approved premises first, while most of the approved premises' positives were cured inside prison by the prison health provider, whose own treatment log holds those cures, so the pharmacy needle exchange registrants, the least treated, lead.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is each setting's count of people with active hepatitis C the team would find and start on treatment, the epidemiologist's antibody positives times the share still viraemic, where an antibody persists for life after a cure, the never-treated keep the natural three-quarters chronic share after spontaneous clearance and a person treated in prison is cured in the prison health provider's record and not the network's; put another field's units in and an antibody that outlives the infection, a laboratory that never re-tests a known positive for antibody and a cure recorded by whichever organisation gave it stop meaning anything.

driver: The forward pool is the units still carrying an active condition among those a marker reads positive, estimated as the positives less those a removal programme's record shows cleared, times the active share the validating data shows; every validating case was a unit the condition had never been removed from, because the producing process tests the marker only on units not already known positive and predates the removal push, while the removal was given by two organisations each keeping its own record, so the forward units cleared by the second organisation look uncleared in the first's record and only a unit-by-unit join to the second's record finds them, which drops the group the first record leaves largest and lifts the one neither reached.
driver_concrete: Each setting's people with active hepatitis C in its 2027 intake: the laboratory's first antibody positives and the 2018-19 pilot show about three quarters viraemic because nobody in them had been treated, the network's register removes the cures its own clinics gave, and the prison health provider's log holds the cures given inside, which are most of the approved premises' positives, so the needle exchange registrants lead.
stump: A competent solver takes each setting's 2027 intake, its antibody positives, removes the cures the network's treatment register shows and carries the rest at the three-quarters viraemic share, and files the approved premises first; the step that lands it there is treating the network's register as the record of every cure when the approved premises' positives were mostly cured inside prison, in the prison health provider's own treatment log.

differentiation.task144: task144 discounts a conversion inflated by a launch burst; task304 removes from a marker-positive count the units a second organisation's treatment record shows cleared, unit by unit.
differentiation.task268: task268 carries departed units' survival by their state at departure; task304 has no censoring: cleared units are read from two providers' treatment records and the validated active share applies only to the rest.
differentiation.task150: task150 splits next-period counts into carried members, steady arrivals and transfers; task304 splits a marker-positive count into units still carrying the condition and units a curative programme cleared.
differentiation.task179: task179 reads each member's leaving chance at its own peer co-membership; task304 reads each positive's cure from whichever organisation treated it, which the validating ratio never saw.
differentiation.task501: task501 sets a threshold by a contact matrix's eigenvalue; task304 is a count of active cases among marker positives after curative treatment given by two providers.
differentiation.task304: architecture 1 carried a concession hidden in a remaining-term path through a fitted delayed hazard; architecture 2 has no hazard to fit: cured positives are read from two providers' treatment records and the never-treated carry the validated viraemic share.
